newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israeli soldiers wound three Arabs in West Bank.
newsitem.headline: Israeli soldiers wound three Arabs in West Bank.

text.p: Israeli soldiers fired on Palestinians in a West Bank village near Jerusalem on Tuesday wounding three, Israel Radio said.
The radio said the soldiers opened fire after "a confrontation" with residents of the Hizmeh village. It gave no other details.
Medical workers said one of the Palestinians was seriously wounded and two sustained light injuries.
An army spokesman confirmed a shooting incident had occurred in the village north of Jerusalem but said it had no other information.
